config.selection: maximum validation AUROC; single-class validation negative logloss; exact ties smaller C
config.final_fit: selected train-fitted model; no train+validation refit
config.weighting: equal person base weight then class balance; training-prior logit correction
config.native_score_direction: higher score is greater warning risk; never selected from validation or test

dnb.input: 9 state coordinates; state count comes from the node array

mmdev.adaptation: past-only median-filled ISOMAP/S-map, daily32 history and24 local window, E1..6; retain undefined scores as NaN

config.threshold: linear90th percentile of finite validation negative scores; test alerts use strictly greater than threshold
config.zero_shot: frozen earlier Humans source risk mappings trained on RESILIENT and BrisT1D-Open; no College model fitting or C selection; P90 threshold calibration uses College validation negatives
config.common_population: intersection of finite scores across every method managed by this runner
config.within_person_definition: equal-person mean AUROC among people with both classes
config.primary_comparison: paired common-population cluster intervals; all-population metrics retain each method's actual coverage
config.primary_selection: C in [0.01,0.1,1] using training and validation only; no train+validation refit
config.primary_population: origins scoreable by all primary methods; also report all scored origins and coverage
config.primary_metric: test AUROC with 2000 participant cluster bootstrap replicates
config.strongest_control_difference: HNE AUROC minus maximum AUROC among predeclared controls; repeat control maximization inside each bootstrap draw
config.endpoint: unchanged configs/daily_protocol.json:56 reference days,32 history days,1 gap day,7 future days,at least2 abnormal families

public_baselines.checkpoint_selection: unchanged original validation loss in vendor runners
public_baselines.FCM_future: 32-day same-channel future array; only future_available=true training/validation windows enter network fitting
public_baselines.imputation: per-channel training-history median; all-missing channel numerical placeholder0; no temporal padding
public_baselines.ensemble: all3 fixed seeds; arithmetic mean of validation-negative ECDF scores
public_baselines.score_LR: separate supplementary one-score readout; C in [0.01,0.1,1] by validation logloss

config.test_policy: fit opens train/validation only; predict requires explicit all-methods-frozen confirmation and uses selected checkpoints without fitting
